stem: The number of planes arriving at an airport every hour during daytime is modelled by the random variable $X$ with distribution $\text{Po}(5.2)$.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: State two assumptions required for the Poisson model to be valid in this context.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the probability that the number of planes arriving in a 15-minute period is greater than 1 and less than 4,

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Find the probability that more than 3 planes will arrive in a 40-minute period.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text: The airport has enough staff to deal with a maximum of 60 planes landing during a 10-hour day. Use a suitable approximation to find the probability that, on a randomly chosen 10-hour day, staff will be able to deal with all the planes that land.
